one_liner: Manages Qualico brand knowledge, product data, VAT registrations, and company identity across Notion, Supabase, Google Drive, and Airtable.

intelligence.notes: Basic for simple lookups; advanced for most tasks; expert for PDF generation, complex data analysis, or multi-step syncs.

capabilities: Scrape qualico.be and build brand knowledge overview
Maintain Qualico brand identity in Notion and Supabase
Sync VAT registrations from Airtable to Supabase (13 countries)
Process and push pitchdeck data to Supabase shared_knowledge
Generate product overview PDFs (Puzzlup SKUs, pricing, margins)
Maintain interactive brand overview app in Tasklet
Upload deliverables to Google Drive Output folder
Push brand briefings to Notion AI Agent Briefings database
Check and respond to agent_requests from Tim
Enforce brand name accuracy (Bauwee, not BAUBAU)
Query and update Supabase shared brain
Run network listener to check directives and answered requests

example_queries: Push pitchdeck data to shared brain

subagents.purpose: Checks Supabase agent_requests for Tim's answers and Notion Active Broadcast Directives page. Was previously run 3x/day on a schedule trigger (deleted per Directive #28).
Submits agent audit data directly to Supabase Agent_Audit_Status table. Created during April 2026 agent audit.

connections.what_for: Read/write brand knowledge pages, AI Agent Briefings, Company Overview
Shared brain — read/write shared_knowledge, vat_registrations, Puzzlup product tables, Agents_Overview
Upload deliverables to Marketing & Sales / Qualico Brand Agent Output folder, download pitchdeck from Input folder
Read VAT-Info table from Finance & Accounting base (13 countries)

webhook.notes: Network Listener trigger deleted per Directive #28 (March 30, 2026) — overhead triggers removed fleet-wide.

key_rules: Brand name is ALWAYS Bauwee (not BAUBAU) — correct any reference that says BAUBAU
READ shared_knowledge before starting work, WRITE findings after
Everything tagged with domain=company in Supabase
Use agent_requests table when blocked — never silently abandon tasks
DARE accountability: every task ends in DONE or ESCALATED
Start at advanced intelligence, shift up only when stuck, shift back down immediately

input_format.accepts: Brand questions, product data requests, VAT lookups, company identity queries, knowledge sync requests
example_queries: What is Qualico's VAT number in France?
Update the Bauwee brand overview in Notion
Generate a product overview PDF for Puzzlup
Sync VAT registrations from Airtable to Supabase
Push pitchdeck findings to shared brain

output_format.returns: Structured data, Notion page updates, PDF files, Supabase inserts, Google Drive uploads

cooperation_partners.how: Receives broadcast directives via Notion Active Broadcast Directives page
Shares VAT registration data via Supabase vat_registrations table

databases_tables.what_for: Brand identity, strategy, financials, agent deliverables
VAT numbers for 13 countries synced from Airtable
Product catalog with SKUs and dimensions
Write when blocked, read Tim's answers
